annotations.title: WhatsApp link to talk to us

description: A WhatsApp click-to-chat link with a pre-filled message (topic, plants, community and notes) for when the person wants a quote, a visit or help from our team. Nothing is sent until they press send in WhatsApp.

community.description: The person's Dubai community, e.g. "Arabian Ranches".

note.description: Anything the person wants to say, in their words (up to 500 characters).

plants.description: Up to 20 plants (slugs or names) the person is interested in; they are listed in the message.

topic.description: What the message is about: garden-care, build (a garden makeover), design (a plan from the 3D garden planner), plants, kitchen-garden, what-to-plant, styles or general. Defaults to plants when plants are given, else general.
